flags.purpose: Queries a specific registry value name under a key to retrieve exact configuration data.
flags.security_use_case: Inspect autorun entries in Run keys to detect malware persistence.
flags.threat_detected: Startup persistence via Run keys; unauthorized software launching at boot.
flags.risk_if_misused: None; read-only. Requires careful escaping of long paths in scripts.
flags.safe_followup: Back up key, then remove suspicious entries with reg delete after validation.

flags.purpose: Recursively searches all subkeys and values under a key for matching patterns.
flags.security_use_case: Hunt across registry hives for suspicious paths or persistence artifacts.
flags.threat_detected: Scattered registry-based persistence and configuration storage by malware.
flags.risk_if_misused: Time-consuming on large hives; produces large output requiring filtering.
flags.safe_followup: Export suspicious keys for analysis before any modification.

flags.purpose: Searches registry value data for matching content instead of key names.
flags.security_use_case: Find encoded PowerShell commands or script paths stored in registry.
flags.threat_detected: Registry-stored PowerShell payloads for persistence or C2 configuration.
flags.risk_if_misused: May return many legitimate matches; requires analyst review.
flags.safe_followup: Decode suspicious base64 values; review execution policies.

flags.purpose: Searches only key names for pattern matches, ignoring values and data.
flags.security_use_case: Locate software-related registry keys for audit or cleanup.
flags.threat_detected: Orphaned or suspicious keys from incomplete uninstallations.
flags.safe_followup: Compare with installed programs; review orphaned entries.

flags.purpose: Filters results by registry value type such as REG_SZ, REG_DWORD, REG_BINARY.
flags.security_use_case: Check numeric security-related configurations altered by malware.
flags.threat_detected: DWORD-based security settings modified to weaken protections.
flags.safe_followup: Compare values with known-good baselines before correction.

flags.purpose: Displays numeric type equivalents to aid programmatic comparison of values.
flags.security_use_case: Automated compliance checks of security registry configurations.
flags.threat_detected: Unexpected type/value changes in security configurations.
flags.risk_if_misused: None; read-only. Output parsing adjustments needed.
flags.safe_followup: Parse numeric output for automated validation scripts.

flags.purpose: Accesses the 32-bit registry view (WOW6432Node) on 64-bit systems.
flags.security_use_case: Detect 32-bit malware persistence paths on 64-bit Windows.
flags.threat_detected: Malware hiding in 32-bit registry redirection paths.
flags.risk_if_misused: None; read-only. Relevant only on 64-bit systems.

powerful_combinations.command: reg query "HKLM\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run" /s && reg query "HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run" /s && reg query "HKLM\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\RunOnce" /s
powerful_combinations.why_powerful: Enumerates all primary Windows autorun locations used for persistence.
powerful_combinations.security_context: Comprehensive startup persistence discovery before deeper forensics.

powerful_combinations.why_powerful: Finds services executing from suspicious directories like Temp or user folders.
powerful_combinations.security_context: Detect malicious services planted outside standard system paths.

powerful_combinations.why_powerful: Identifies file association handlers that execute commands, often abused for code execution.
powerful_combinations.security_context: Detect COM hijacking or file association abuse for privilege escalation.
